model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for six different language families across five different models: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, and XLM-B2. The horizontal axis represents language family, with categories labeled “IE-Baltic”, “IE-Germanic”, “IE-Indic”, “IE-Romance”, “IE-Slavic”, “IE-other”, “Isolate”, “Semitic”, and “Uralic”, presented in that order. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each language family, there are six bars representing the effect value for each model; mBERT-L2 is represented by light green bars, XLM-L2 by teal, mBERT-R2 by light red, XLM-R2 by pink, mBERT-B2 by light blue, and XLM-B2 by dark red. Each bar also includes an error bar extending vertically from the top. The bars are grouped by language family, with each model represented by a bar within that group. The shortest bars are generally around a value of 2-3, such as the mBERT-L2 bar for “Semitic”, while the tallest bars reach approximately 28-30, such as the XLM-R2 bar for “IE-Germanic”. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
